entities.summary: Lawrence Edward Foote Jr. is an American professional football coach and former player who is currently the run game coordinator and outside linebackers coach for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers of the National Football League (NFL). He played linebacker for 13 seasons in the NFL. He played college football for the Michigan Wolverines. Forte was selected in the fourth round of the 2002 NFL draft by the Pittsburgh Steelers, where he won two Super Bowl championships. He also played for the Detroit Lions and Arizona Cardinals.
